architecture.geometry_only: shared per-conformer scalar-vector EGNN/GVP with sequence edges, disjoint 4.5/8/16 Angstrom spatial shells, pLDDT edge weighting and set-attention
architecture.disentangled: geometry_only plus same-sequence identity consistency, conformer-state geometry reconstruction and state anti-collapse losses
architecture.initialization: frozen fold0 chemical-site base; only the new geometric residual was trainable

representation_diagnostics.interpretation: the auxiliary objectives successfully disentangled and reconstructed conformer geometry, but this representation change did not improve toxicity classification

probability_effect.source_interpretation: the already-small response was concentrated in PepFlow short peptides; AF2/ColabFold changes were nearly zero

failed_gate_reasons: MCC improvement was 0 instead of the required +0.002
Brier score worsened instead of improving by at least 0.0001
disentanglement reduced AUPRC relative to geometry_only
decision: do not retain code, checkpoints or the 1.2 GB derived graph tensor; do not modify README or the default model; do not repeat without a new supervision hypothesis
